text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels.
Forum Island - (built 1976) 30,230 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $1.5 million at auction in Galveston.
Magic Confidence - (built 1982) 21,317 dwt sold to Taiwanese buyers for $6.15 million.
Jin Jiling - (built 1985) 20,333 dwt sold to Mediterranean based buyers for $4.85 million.
Pu Tuo Ling - (built 1985) 20,330 dwt sold to Mediterranean based buyers for $4.85 million
Oranienburg and sistership Hennigsdorf - both (built 1986) 23,929 dwt sold to Turkish buyers for $14 million en-bloc.
Uri - (built 1983) 12,271 dwt sold to Chinese buyers for $5.5 million with two or three years timecharter back at $6,750 daily.
Oriental Hawk - (built 1984) 11,073 dwt sold to Malaysian buyers for $4.28 million.
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to survey, inspection or other conditions.
